body1:
This task is part of a research study conducted by Dr. Naama Ilany-Tzur at Carnegie Mellon University.

Purpose

The purpose of the research is to investigate how people work together with AI agents on short everyday tasks.

Procedure

Next you will answer a few short questions about your background. You will then be redirected to a webpage in which you will be asked to complete short tasks with the help of an AI agent, followed by a few questions about your experience. The expected duration of participation is about 45 minutes.

Participant Requirements

Participation in this study is limited to individuals age 18 and older.

Risk

The risks and discomfort associated with participation in this study are no greater than those ordinarily encountered in daily life or during other online activities. Specifically, there is the risk of disclosing personal information while interacting with the AI agent. Please do not disclose any personal information or identifiable information throughout this study. In case you do we will delete this information as soon as possible. If you feel any discomfort, you should end your participation immediately.

Benefits

There may be no personal benefit from your participation in the study but the knowledge received may be of value the general understanding of how users are interacting with AI agents and what affects this interaction.

Compensation & Costs

Upon completing your participation, you will be eligible for compensation as specified in Prolific. Please make sure you reach the final page and copy the completion code. There will be no cost to you if you participate in this study

Future Use of Information

In the future once we have removed all identifiable information from your data, we may use it for our research studies, or we may distribute the data to other researchers for their research studies. We would do this without getting additional informed consent from you. Sharing of data with other researchers will only be done in such a manner that you will not be identified.

Confidentiality

The data captured for the research does not include any personally identifiable information about you. Your IP address will not be captured. The study will collect your research data through your use of a Salesforce web server. This company is not owned by CMU. The company will have access to the research data that you produce and any identifiable information that you share with them while using their product. Please note that CMU does not control the Terms and Conditions of the company or how they will use or protect any information that they collect.

Right to Ask Questions & Contact Information

If you have any questions about this study, you should feel free to ask them by contacting the Principal Investigator now at nilanytz@andrew.cmu.edu. If you have questions later, desire additional information, or wish to withdraw your participation, please contact the Principal Investigator by e-mail in accordance with the contact information listed above.
If you have questions pertaining to your rights as a research participant, or you wish to report concerns, you should contact the Office of Research integrity and Compliance at Carnegie Mellon University. Email: irb-review@andrew.cmu.edu . Phone: 412-268-4721.

Voluntary Participation

Your participation in this research is voluntary. You may discontinue participation at any time during the research activity. You may print a copy of this consent form for your records.
